20:/** @typedef {false | {version: string|null}} JSLibraryDetectorTestResult */
21:/**
22: * @typedef JSLibraryDetectorTest
23: * @property {string} id
24: * @property {string} icon
25: * @property {string} url
26: * @property {string|null} npm npm module name, if applicable to library.
27: * @property {function(Window): JSLibraryDetectorTestResult | Promise<JSLibraryDetectorTestResult>} test Returns false if library is not present, otherwise returns an object that contains the library version (set to null if the version is not detected).
28: */

33: * @property {string} name

38:/**
39: * Obtains a list of detected JS libraries and their versions.
40: */
41:/* istanbul ignore next */
42:async function detectLibraries() {
43:  /** @type {JSLibrary[]} */
44:  const libraries = [];
45:
46:  // d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e_ is a consistent prefix used by the detect libraries
47:  // see https://github.com/HTTPArchive/httparchive/issues/77#issuecomment-291320900
48:  /** @type {Record<string, JSLibraryDetectorTest>} */
49:  // @ts-ignore - injected libDetectorSource var
50:  const libraryDetectorTests = d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e_LibraryDetectorTests; // eslint-disable-line 
51:
52:  for (const [name, lib] of Object.entries(libraryDetectorTests)) {
53:    try {
54:      const result = await lib.test(window);
55:      if (result) {
56:        libraries.push({
57:          id: lib.id,
58:          name: name,
59:          version: result.version,
60:          npm: lib.npm,
61:        });
62:      }
63:    } catch (e) {}
64:  }
65:
66:  return libraries;
67:}

88:  }));
